pages.lesson:
LESSON: READING 5.2.1 EXTENSIVE READING: FICTION AND NON FICTION MATERIALS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
Strand: Strand 5
Topic 5.2: Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What materials do you enjoy reading?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. select relevant reading materials from a collection of books
2. scan a text to obtain specific information
3. skim through digital or print texts to establish appropriateness and relevance

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. select relevant reading materials from a collection of books
   In simple words: practise until you can select relevant reading materials from a collection of books. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. scan a text to obtain specific information
   In simple words: practise until you can scan a text to obtain specific information. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

3. skim through digital or print texts to establish appropriateness and relevance
   In simple words: practise until you can skim through digital or print texts to establish appropriateness and relevance. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials in the examples.
2. Explain Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials.
4. Show that you can: select relevant reading materials from a collection of books

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Reading 5.2.1 Extensive Reading: Fiction and Non Fiction Materials important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Read selected materials independently,
2. Communication and Collaboration is enhanced as the learner sets up an after-school reading club where they meet regularly with peers to read.
3. Digital Literacy is attained as the learner sources for a variety of reading materials online.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What materials do you enjoy reading?
2. Why is it necessary to read many books?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. select relevant reading materials from a collection of books
2. scan a text to obtain specific information
3. skim through digital or print texts to establish appropriateness and relevance

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
